lines.t: Walk O'Reilly in me, in my very footstep Abide in the doctrine given in truth
Hold fast to the faith you receive within And the knowledge I've written you
Progress toward perfection with all trust in my word
Keep the commandments, there's light to be heard
Testified by the life that you live
Turn from the world, let your spirit give
No more walk in the ways of this world
For its shadows will vanish away
Stand in the peace I abhor within
Let my truth be your strength each day
Progress toward perfection with all trust in my word
Keep the commandments, it's light to be heard
Testified by the life that you live
Turn from the world, let your spirit give
Impatience endured and mercy remained
For my footsteps are passed through the rain
Rise up in faith, let your voice proclaim
Love unending, forever my name
Progress to perfection, with all trust in my word
Keep the command, this is life to be heard
Walk rightly in me, as you testify truth
For I am the life abiding in you
Walking rightly in me, in my very footsteps
